formation.explanation: Leader preparation collects per-pid promises, selects prior history, enters Accept and synchronizes followers. Local proposals append/batch, followers acknowledge accepted indexes, and leader accepts a decision only after the configured acceptance quorum. Decision propagation uses Decide or piggybacking. Public reads export entries below cached decided index and return stored snapshot copies for compacted ranges. Batch acknowledgments reflect flushed entries; tick can flush incomplete batches.

context.explanation: BLE heartbeat rounds propose leadership; SequencePaxos only initiates local leadership above its prior leader and promise. A follower persists a qualifying promise before responding, rejects old ballots and requires preparation before AcceptSync. Recovery permits same-ballot Prepare; new local leadership resets support accounting. Build validates configuration and initializes clocks and recovered promise. Message dispatch itself adds no membership or configuration guard. Reconfiguration requires a decided StopSign before caller starts the next instance.

connection.explanation: Preparation flushes pending batches before reporting accepted history. The selected accepted round/index and decided index constrain the new leader history; pending proposals append only if no accepted StopSign. Current-ballot acceptance and per-follower message sequences qualify later advancement. Gaps request resynchronization; old ballots cannot directly append at followers. InternalStorage installs selected history and accepted round through an atomic storage transaction before acknowledgment. Snapshots can carry the decided prefix plus an ordinary suffix; the Delta consumer bases reconstruction on the newly cached decided index; when the corresponding local interval is unavailable, MemoryStorage returns an empty base interval before merging the incoming delta.
